recommendations.title: Improve Narratives entry clarity
recommendations.recommendation: Tune Arrival copy and Quickball arrival suggestions so users understand when to choose Narratives. Do not add more entry doors.
recommendations.liquid_glass_guardrail: Preserve two doors. Do not add dashboard-first navigation or a third Arrival option.
